scripts.model:typecheck: quint typecheck models/main.qnt && quint typecheck models/retro/reconciler.qnt && for f in models/board/*/*.qnt; do quint typecheck $f || exit 1; done
scripts.model:test: quint test models/main.qnt --main=main && quint test models/retro/reconciler.qnt --main=retro
scripts.model:validation: pnpm model:typecheck && pnpm model:test && pnpm model:simulate && pnpm model:replay && pnpm model:verify
